court: In the High Court of Madras
respondents: Commissioner, Office of the Greater Chennai Corporation and Another
advocates: For Respondents: Ms. Karthikaa Ashok, Standing Counsel
judgment_text:
Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying for issuance of Writ of Mandamus directing the respondents not to construct new channel for rain water drain connecting from Alandur through Abraham Street, Adambakkam and Second Main Street, Officers Colony, Adambakkam, Chennai-600 088.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

T.S. Sivagnanam, J.:— Heard Mr. M. Jaikumar, learned counsel for the petitioner and Ms. Karthikaa Ashok, learned Standing Counsel accepting notice on behalf of the respondents.

2. With consent on either side, this writ petition is taken up for final disposal.

3. The petitioner seeks for a direction upon the respondents not to construct new channel for rain water drain connecting from Alandur through Abraham Street, Adambakkam and Second Main Street, Officers Colony, Adambakkam, Chennai.

4. Admittedly, every area requires a stormwater drain and it is not sufficient that the respondent-Corporation provides a stormwater drain alone, but they have to ensure that the stormwater drain is maintained properly and it does not become a drainage channel. In Fact, the apprehension of the petitioner Mr. K. Jayaraman, is same as expressed by this Court. The petitioner's apprehension appears to be genuine because past experience in the Chennai City clearly shows that stormwater drain has slowly become drainage channel. The Corporation of Chennai has not been able to take effective steps to prevent people from illegally letting out drainage water into stormwater drain.

5. Ms. Karthikaa Ashok, learned Standing Counsel for the respondent-Corporation submitted that since Alandur has been annexed to the Greater Chennai Corprotion, necessarily stormwater drainage has to be provided linking Alandur and Adambakkam, so that the area is not inundated. Construction of channel, the route to be adopted, etc., are all technical matters which have to be decided by the respondent-Corporation, but however, such decision should be in public interest. It should not be as if the residents of Alandur alone to be benefited at the cost of the residents in Adambakkam. Therefore, whatever work done by the respondent-Corporation should be on the basis of the general public in both the areas and there should be adequate supervision, so that the channel is formed with least inconvenience to the residents of the area.

6. Though the representation given by the Officers Colony residents and Association has not been pursued, that does not mean that the respondent-Corporation can proceed as per their whims and fancies. The channel should be formed in such a manner that it does not affect any of the residents of Adambakkam and path of the channel should be so aligned to avoid deep curves, so that there is free flow of rain water. After construction of channel, the respondent-Corporation should maintain the same and conduct periodical inspection to ensure that the owners of the properties adjoining the channel do not illegally let out drainage water into the stormwater drain.

7. With the above observations, this writ petition stands disposed of. No costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
